key: Add additional tanks as needed (stock tank 1 always stays). Do not switch senders onto the PCM FLI pin (false fill). Each extra tank needs its own Torque extra PID (MCU Mode 22, unique name — not 012F or Ford 16C1). Select-PID value is the 1-based tank id. Gal/hr is charged only to the active tank.
source: Add additional tanks as needed (stock tank 1 always stays). Do not switch senders onto the PCM FLI pin (false fill). Each extra tank needs its own Torque extra PID (MCU Mode 22, unique name — not 012F or Ford 16C1). Select-PID value is the 1-based tank id. Gal/hr is charged only to the active tank.
text: Gehitu depositu gehigarriak behar izanez gero (1. fabrikako depositua beti geratzen da). Ez konektatu sentsoreak PCM FLI pinera (betetze faltsua). Depositu gehigarri bakoitzak bere Torque PID gehigarria behar du (MCU Mode 22, izen bakarra — ez 012F edo Ford 16C1). Select-PID balioa 1etik aurrerako depositu-identifikatzailea da. Gal/hr depositu aktiboari soilik egozten zaio.

key: Writes a value onto Torque's stock Fuel Level (012F) so existing gauges show it: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit. A fit that is not built yet writes the smoothed level.
source: Writes a value onto Torque's stock Fuel Level (012F) so existing gauges show it: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit. A fit that is not built yet writes the smoothed level.
text: Balio bat idazten du Torque-ren fabrikako Fuel Level (012F) gainean, dauden neurgailuek erakuts dezaten: Itzalita, leundua edo Chunk, Band edo Kalman doikuntzatik zuzendua. Oraindik eraiki gabeko doikuntza batek maila leundua idazten du.

key: Requires Torque Pro (paid). Torque Lite does not support plugins.
source: Requires Torque Pro (paid). Torque Lite does not support plugins.
text: Torque Pro behar da (ordainpekoa). Torque Lite-k ez ditu pluginak onartzen.

key: The name of this vehicle profile. Each Torque vehicle profile gets its own plugin profile, data and learned maps.

key: Vehicle make (e.g. Ford). Used only to choose which brand-specific fuel PIDs detection may try.
source: Vehicle make (e.g. Ford). Used only to choose which brand-specific fuel PIDs detection may try.
text: Ibilgailuaren marka (adib. Ford). Detekzioak zein marka-erregai PID proba ditzakeen aukeratzeko soilik erabiltzen da.

key: Where the raw fuel level comes from. Detect (needs the ECU connected) tries the candidates read-only and asks you to confirm unless two sources agree. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. None = detect on the next connect.
source: Where the raw fuel level comes from. Detect (needs the ECU connected) tries the candidates read-only and asks you to confirm unless two sources agree. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. None = detect on the next connect.

key:
Quick start
 1. Install Torque Pro (the paid version; Torque Lite does not support plugins) and pair your OBD-II adapter.
 2. Enable this plugin in Torque → Settings → Plugins.
 3. Allow notifications, and set battery use to Unrestricted so Torque can start this plugin in the background.
 4. In Torque, select the vehicle profile for the car you are driving. Data is kept per Torque profile and checked against the vehicle's VIN/ECU identity.
 5. On a new profile the fuel source is detected when you connect; if asked, compare it with your dash gauge and tap Confirm. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. You can also pick it below.
 6. There is no tank size to enter here. Each fit learns its own size, shown under Learned tank size; until then its corrected percent reads 1:1 with the gauge. Enter your tank size in the Torque vehicle profile for Torque's own remaining fuel and DTE.
 7. In Torque, add gauges for [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level and each fit's Corrected % and Tank size. The plugin does not publish remaining fuel or DTE. A notice during a refit says that fit reads 1:1 until its refit finishes.
 8. Feed fuel level back to Torque: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit onto your 012F gauge. Torque's own fuel remaining and DTE then use that level with the tank size and long-term mpg in the Torque profile.
 9. Fuel is counted only while the engine runs. The plugin runs only while Torque is connected to the ECU.
 10. Keep driving and filling up; accuracy builds over several partial tanks. If the plugin cannot tell which vehicle this is, it asks in a notification and on this page; choose what to do with that drive.
 11. All data stays on this phone. No GPS or location is recorded.
source:
Quick start
 1. Install Torque Pro (the paid version; Torque Lite does not support plugins) and pair your OBD-II adapter.
 2. Enable this plugin in Torque → Settings → Plugins.
 3. Allow notifications, and set battery use to Unrestricted so Torque can start this plugin in the background.
 4. In Torque, select the vehicle profile for the car you are driving. Data is kept per Torque profile and checked against the vehicle's VIN/ECU identity.
 5. On a new profile the fuel source is detected when you connect; if asked, compare it with your dash gauge and tap Confirm. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. You can also pick it below.
 6. There is no tank size to enter here. Each fit learns its own size, shown under Learned tank size; until then its corrected percent reads 1:1 with the gauge. Enter your tank size in the Torque vehicle profile for Torque's own remaining fuel and DTE.
 7. In Torque, add gauges for [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level and each fit's Corrected % and Tank size. The plugin does not publish remaining fuel or DTE. A notice during a refit says that fit reads 1:1 until its refit finishes.
 8. Feed fuel level back to Torque: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit onto your 012F gauge. Torque's own fuel remaining and DTE then use that level with the tank size and long-term mpg in the Torque profile.
 9. Fuel is counted only while the engine runs. The plugin runs only while Torque is connected to the ECU.
 10. Keep driving and filling up; accuracy builds over several partial tanks. If the plugin cannot tell which vehicle this is, it asks in a notification and on this page; choose what to do with that drive.
 11. All data stays on this phone. No GPS or location is recorded.
text:
Hasiera azkarra
 1. Instalatu Torque Pro (ordainpeko bertsioa; Torque Lite-k ez ditu pluginak onartzen) eta parekatu OBD-II egokigailua.
 2. Gaitu plugin hau Torque → Ezarpenak → Pluginak atalean.
 3. Baimendu jakinarazpenak eta ezarri bateriaren erabilera Mugarik gabe, Torque-k plugin hau atzeko planoan abiaraz dezan.
 4. Torque-n aukeratu gidatzen ari zaren ibilgailuaren profila. Datuak Torque profilaka gordetzen dira eta ibilgailuaren VIN/ECU identitatearekin egiaztatzen dira.
 5. Profil berri batean erregai-iturria konektatzean hautematen da; eskatzen bazaizu, alderatu aginte-paneleko neurgailuarekin eta sakatu Berretsi. Berretsi konfigurazio-orrian eta jakinarazpenean dago. Behean ere aukera dezakezu.
 6. Hemen ez dago deposituaren tamainarik sartzeko. Doikuntza bakoitzak bere tamaina ikasten du, Ikasi den deposituaren tamaina atalean; ordura arte haren ehuneko zuzenduak 1:1 irakurtzen du neurgailuarekin. Sartu deposituaren tamaina Torque-ren ibilgailu-profilean, Torque-ren beraren geratzen den erregaiarentzat eta DTE-rentzat.
 7. Torque-n gehitu neurgailuak [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Levelerako eta doikuntza bakoitzerako Corrected % eta Tank size. Pluginak ez du geratzen den erregairik edo DTE-rik argitaratzen. Berdoikuntza batean abisu batek esaten du doikuntzak 1:1 irakurtzen duela berdoikuntza amaitu arte.
 8. Itzuli erregai-maila Torque-ra: Itzalita, leundua edo Chunk, Band edo Kalman doikuntzatik zuzendua, 012F neurgailura. Torque-ren beraren geratzen den erregaiak eta DTE-k maila hori erabiltzen dute gero deposituaren tamainarekin eta Torque profilaren epe luzeko mpg-arekin.
 9. Erregaia motorra martxan dagoen bitartean soilik zenbatzen da. Plugina Torque ECU-ra konektatuta dagoen bitartean soilik exekutatzen da.
 10. Jarraitu gidatzen eta betetzen; zehaztasuna hainbat depositu partzialetan hobetzen da. Pluginak ezin badu esan zein ibilgailu den, jakinarazpen batean eta orri honetan galdetzen du; aukeratu zer egin bidaia horrekin.
 11. Datu guztiak telefono honetan geratzen dira. Ez da GPS edo kokapenik erregistratzen.

source: Asks which vehicle is connected when it cannot be matched automatically.
